notes: SR 126 is the UK entry for Anthropologie (anthropologie.com), a sibling of SR 7 (US Anthropologie Home, same domain). Per the prior Home-Decor pass for this SR (notes/126.md), a genuine distinct UK storefront exists at the /en-gb/ locale path (anthropologie.co.uk/.eu both 301/302 to /en-gb/, distinct GB nav/slugs, GBP pricing, separate en-gb sitemap index, UK-only legal pages). I independently re-verified this is not just a re-priced mirror specifically for Pet Care rather than reusing SR 7's US numbers: fetched /en-gb/home (the broad combined Home+Furniture+Textiles catalog, 3873 products unfiltered, canonical/og:url confirms en-gb, prices render in GBP not USD) and applied the same attributionProductType=Pet+Accessories facet filter that resolved SR 7's category. Result: 18 products on the UK site vs 75 on the US site (c7/pc7) for the identical facet name - a materially different count, proving the UK catalog population for Pet Accessories is genuinely distinct, not shared/duplicated with the US listing. Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (User-agent: * / Allow: /, separate en-gb/fr-fr/de-de/etc sitemap indexes listed). Reached via direct HTTP tier 1 only (curl_cffi, chrome124 TLS impersonation) - no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed; DataDome did not block this session for these ~10 paced requests. Checked: (1) main GB nav link scrape from /en-gb/home (no 'Pets' nav item; only 'Petite' clothing line, unrelated). (2) /en-gb/categories_sitemap.xml (1093 URLs) - only pet-adjacent slug found is /en-gb/christmas-gifts-pets, titled 'Gifts for Pet Lovers & Owners' / H1 'Pet Lover Gifts' (71 products) - checked its actual product tiles: mix of one genuine pet product (Molly Hatch Stoneware Pet Bowl) among mostly human/pet-owner items (Molly Hatch Stoneware Dog Mug, dog-breed Christmas ornaments, a t-shirt, tea towel) - excluded per brief's 'pet lover gifts' / gift-guide exclusion rule, not a real Pet Care category. (3) /en-gb/home-decor-all (the narrower 'Home Décor' bucket, 1407 products) - its embedded Product Type facet list (23 values, extracted from the SSR category.facets JSON) has NO Pet Accessories value at all, and confirmed 0 products when the attributionProductType=Pet+Accessories filter is applied directly to that URL - Pet Accessories items are classified outside the Home Décor bucket. (4) /en-gb/furniture-all and /en-gb/furniture (the Furniture department hub/PLPs, whose sub-nav has armchairs/beds/chairs/sofas/tables/storage but no pet-specific slug) both returned 0 or no product-count text when the Pet Accessories filter was applied - not the source either. (5) /en-gb/gifts-all filtered by attributionProductType=Pet+Accessories returns 2 products (Small/Large Bistro Tile Pet Bowl), a subset of the 18 found via /en-gb/home - not counted separately to avoid double-counting the same underlying facet population. Net: the only place the UK site's own attributionProductType='Pet Accessories' facet resolves with its full count is the broad combined /en-gb/home catalog (18 products), which is recorded below - mirroring exactly how SR 7's 'Pet Accessories' (75, on the US home-catalog page) was found, but independently confirmed as a numerically distinct UK-specific figure.
